ownerChoices.choice: The RC5 test passes additionalCorePublicationConstructors: ["constructWorksiteCommandExecutionModulePublication"]. installed-language-test.mjs forwards it unchanged to the existing root-installed-environment option, which constructs the publication through the installed gtl owner from the packed candidate basis. The fixture declares no T and sets no semanticLifecycle.

New explicit opt-in option crossPublicationProgram, forwarded by installed-language-test.mjs. When it is true, setupInstalledRootCatalog leaves the selected root Program out of publication-local validation. Once the genuine Catalog and CatalogView exist, it calls product.resolveProgramDeclarationClosure(catalog, catalogView, rootProgramRef), then product.constructCatalogProgramValidationInput(catalog, catalogView, closure, closureProgram), then validator.validateProgram. A closure refusal, raw_admission_refusal or static_validation_refusal fails with its JSON as the assertion message. The program is taken from closure.programPublication. No rival inventory or success flag. When the option is absent, behaviour is the same as before, except that local validations are now paired by Program index rather than by result.programRef. A typed refusal therefore reaches the assertion message instead of an undefined dereference, and the every-valid assertion now carries the refusals as its message.

One more leaf.mjs anchor edit in the existing test-local sourceTransform: RC5_CONSUMER_DESCRIPTOR=descriptor('rc5Consumer') is appended to the existing export list and uses the fixture's own descriptor() helper. The fixture package/manifest/install chain in language-structural-fixture.mjs is unchanged.

The test title prefix 'RC5 retained route' is unchanged. New assertions: the fixture publication declares no T. Exactly one admitted ABI CommandExecution publication declares T, equal to product.RETAINED_GRAPH_INPUT_CONTRACT. Both resolution.programDeclarationClosure and resolution.declarationClosure name T's owner exactly as {contract, T, ABI productId, ABI installId, WORKSITE_COMMAND_EXECUTION_IDS.moduleRef, modulePublicationSemanticDigest(publication)}. The setup and execution programValidations name the RC5 Program. The consumer has one implementation row, owned by the fixture, with input T and output S, and its descriptor digest matches exactly one packaged descriptor (rc5Consumer, fixture package, build/leaf.mjs). The existing v1 parent Result, v3 route naming that Result, logical E/S, consumer value S, run_closed and fresh run_result/run_replay assertions are kept unchanged.
